audit.whatIsWrong: The difficulty case was told generically. The real shape is a range problem: Flash Frost reaches 1075 and Frostbite 650, against Null Sphere's 650 — but every point of it is magic damage, which both Kassadin's passive and his shield reduce.
audit.why: Riot: Kassadin 'takes reduced magic damage'; Null Sphere's shield 'absorbs magic damage'. Anivia's whole kit is magic.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeGood, breakdown.early and phases[3].why now state the ranges and why the shield is actually good here.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Kassadin clock line and Rebirth was never priced into any spike.
audit.why: Rebirth reverts Anivia to an egg 'reborn with full health' — so every Kassadin all-in has to burn two bars, which is exactly why the matchup does not flip until the Riftwalk chain is stacked.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, phases[5].why and both late spikes now account for the Egg.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive sequencing was absent: Frostbite deals DOUBLE damage to a target recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm. Also missing: Flash Frost's stun cancels Null Sphere mid-cast.
audit.why: Both are literal in Riot's text — the doubling is the entire reason Flash Frost starts every kill, and Null Sphere is flagged as an interruptible cast.
audit.corrected: enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[4].why and wants.you[2] now carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7, Frostbite a flat 4, Crystallize a flat 17, Glacial Storm 4/3/2.

audit.whatIsWrong: 16 lint findings: Anivia repeatedly called he/his, plus dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles. Separately, spikes[2], spikes[3] and wants.you[2] all describe a Null Sphere 'silence' that does not exist.
audit.why: Anivia is she/her per champ-gender.js. Riot gives Null Sphere channel interruption, not a silence.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten; the three invented silence references replaced with the real interaction.

audit.why: 50.19% over 775 games; no elo split written.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Crystallize blocks Riftwalk is never addressed anywhere on the page, and it is the single most decision-relevant unknown in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot calls Crystallize 'an impassable wall of ice to block all movement' and the kit flags it as terrain that 'blocks paths and dashes'; Riftwalk is described as a teleport, not a dash. The kit files cannot settle whether a blink crosses it. I did not write a claim either way.
